# SoCal Web Experts
> Fast, secure, SEO-ready websites and local digital marketing for Southern California businesses.

This site is for local and service based businesses that need a website that generates leads, not just a brochure. SoCal Web Experts designs and builds custom coded sites with conversion paths (calls, forms, booking), SEO foundations, hosting, and optional Google Ads or social media marketing.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://socalwebexperts.com/): Overview of services, process, portfolio, pricing, and FAQ
- [Services](https://socalwebexperts.com/services/): All services in one place, each linking to its own page
- [Custom Web Design](https://socalwebexperts.com/services/web-design/): Brand-first, conversion-focused websites
- [Social Media Marketing](https://socalwebexperts.com/services/social-media/): On-brand content and posting
- [Google Ads](https://socalwebexperts.com/services/google-ads/): Paid search for high-intent local leads
- [Portfolio](https://socalwebexperts.com/portfolio/): Example client websites
- [Pricing](https://socalwebexperts.com/pricing/): $199 buildout, then Care ($49/mo) or Hosting ($99/yr), and add-ons
- [Get Started](https://socalwebexperts.com/get-started/): Project details form, then plan selection
- [Contact](https://socalwebexperts.com/contact/): Book a free strategy call

## Business facts
- Name: SoCal Web Experts
- Phone: (747) 221-6603
- Email: hello@socalwebexperts.com
- Area served: Los Angeles, Glendale, Orange County, California
- Both plans include the same complete custom website: unlimited pages, brand and logo design, accessibility pages, mobile-ready pages, SEO, forms and click-to-call, reviews, and a review before launch
- Every website is a one-time $199 buildout, then the client chooses Care or Hosting
- Care: $49/mo all-inclusive, with hosting, unlimited edits and pages, support, lead form emails sent to the client, and 1 blog post included. Extra blog posts are $25
- Hosting: $99/yr, billed yearly only (no monthly option), covering hosting and maintenance. Edits are $50 per round, up to 2 pages. Blog posts are $25 each. The client is responsible for their own form email receiving service
- After the second month of Care, clients can switch to Hosting only and are not charged for hosting for that first year
- Clients who cancel and want to keep the website code pay a one-time $199, regardless of prior payments

## Quick answers
- What does SoCal Web Experts do? Builds custom coded, SEO ready websites for local and service businesses in Los Angeles and Orange County, and offers Google Ads management and social media marketing
- How much does a website cost? A one-time $199 buildout, then Care at $49/mo or Hosting at $99/yr
- How fast is launch? Most sites launch in 2 to 5 business days once content and approvals are ready
- Where is the business based? Glendale, California, serving Los Angeles, Glendale, and Orange County
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Pacific
- How do I start? Fill out https://socalwebexperts.com/get-started/ or book a free 15 minute strategy call at https://cal.com/emin-socalwebexperts/15min
- Rankings: no guarantee of #1 Google rankings; the sites are built with SEO foundations, speed, and clear page structure
